versions.subject: rule: Linux cmdline rules
versions.detection:
selection:
  Image|endswith: '/rm'
selection_history:
  - CommandLine|contains: '/.bash_history'
  - CommandLine|endswith: '_history'
condition: selection

versions.subject: Linux rules update
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/rm'
        - '/unlink'
selection_history:
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - '/.bash_history'
        - '/.zsh_history'
    - CommandLine|endswith:
        - '_history'
        - '.history'
        - 'zhistory'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*/rm", "*/unlink") CommandLine IN ("*/.bash_history*", "*/.zsh_history*") OR CommandLine IN ("*_history", "*.history", "*zhistory")
